subject: Budget Shortfall Resolution and Student Suspension Policy
overview: The Committee reviewed reports on a significant budget remediation plan, English Learner enrollment growth, and student behavioral health services. Members also approved several resolutions, most notably one concerning student suspension practices and another supporting a new municipal stabilization fund.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes, bills, and payroll.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates
items.summary: Welcomed new member John Intoppa and announced the upcoming middle school lottery process and a special education transition fair.

items.title: Approval of Donations
items.summary: Accepted donations totaling $6,100 from the J.S. Lim Foundation and Mabbitt & Associates for math and science awards.

items.title: School Choice Recommendation
items.summary: Voted to remain a "no school choice" district for the 2024-2025 school year to avoid potential enrollment costs.

items.title: Budget Shortfall Resolution Report
items.summary: Reviewed a financial report detailing how a projected $2.5 million shortfall was reduced to $216,000 through encumbrance corrections, grant usage, and postponed spending. Members and union representatives discussed concerns regarding future budget impacts and accounting errors.

items.title: Social and Emotional Learning Update
items.summary: Received a presentation on behavioral health staffing, tiers of support, and the STEPS program for students returning from medical or psychiatric leave.

items.title: English Learner Program Update
items.summary: Reviewed enrollment trends showing a district total of 632 English Learner students and discussed the need for a new newcomer classroom at the McGlynn School.

items.title: Resolution 2024-11: MASC Resolutions
items.summary: Reaffirmed support for state-level resolutions concerning menstrual supplies, recess, and the prohibition of Native American mascots; the motion was approved.

items.title: Resolution 2024-12: School Committee Qualifications
items.summary: Approved updates to the committee's ethics training and oath of office policy after a waiver of the first reading.

items.title: Resolution 2024-13: Meeting Accessibility
items.summary: Approved a resolution to mandate the inclusion of video links on the district website and viewing information on all public meeting agendas.

items.title: Resolution 2024-14: Municipal Stabilization Fund
items.summary: Voted to support the creation and funding of a city stabilization fund to cover unexpected capital emergencies and school feasibility studies.

items.title: Resolution 2024-15: Student Suspension Practices
items.summary: Requested a detailed report on disciplinary data and policy compliance following public testimony from a parent regarding an indefinite student suspension. The resolution was approved as amended to include data on police reporting and students with disabilities.

items.title: Resolution 2024-16: Tuition and Rental Rate Cards
items.summary: Directed the administration to provide proposed rate cards for all fee-based programs and rentals by June 30, 2024.
